title: Hearty Cold Spanish Chicken Gazpacho
description: Floral, cheese-pull, and refreshing, this gazpacho dish is perfect for a date night. With its vibrant flavors and low-calorie count, it's a great option for a weeknight meal.
instructions: Combine chicken, 1 cup of water, 2 cloves of minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a blender. Blend until smooth.
Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a large bowl.
Add 2 cups of diced tomatoes, 1 cup of diced red bell pepper, 1 cup of diced cucumber, 1/4 cup of chopped fresh parsley, and 1/4 cup of chopped fresh cilantro to the bowl.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of sherry vinegar and 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in 1/4 cup of crumbled Manchego cheese.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Ladle the gazpacho into bowls and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional parsley and cilantro, if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or crackers on the side, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
